Indian oil companies face significant losses, fuel prices may rise

Three major Indian public sector oil companies, HPCL, BPCL, and IOCL, are reportedly facing a combined loss of ₹47,700 crore in the first quarter. This substantial deficit is attributed to market conditions and could lead to an increase in petrol and diesel prices for consumers.
